title: Homilies on Leviticus, Homilia XIII
blurb: Origen’s Homilia XIII on Leviticus (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–4.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia XIII on Leviticus — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Barkley FOTC 83 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homilia XIII §§1–4 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VI (GCS 29, 1920), Rufinus’s Latin of Homilia XIII. Barkley FOTC 83 was not used as wording. This page is Homilia XIII §§1–4 (closeout).
